svg.title: CuPGeo — architecture and module details, portrait layout
svg.desc: Paper-style architecture diagram: frozen DINOv3-L/16 with LoRA and Pyramid-FPN feeds segmentation and VRA heads. Lower panels expand vertical region allocation, cup-preserving composition, and soft-vCDR supervision. VRA uses a vertical cup prior and uncertainty-gated bounded correction. CP preserves cup probability while adding residual rim; SG affects the cup-to-disc training path only. Predicted and source-mask moments supply training-only soft-vCDR supervision. Input thumbnails and probability maps are synthetic vector illustrations, not dataset images or measured predictions.
